description: Complete manifest authority for concrete Action-owned errors, preserve standard normalization, and distinguish OpenCode Action codes from established runtime diagnostic spelling.

tasks.title: Complete OpenCode Action manifest and boundary mapping
tasks.description: Declare every statically evidenced non-reserved omission in the OpenCode and Pi Agent Action manifests, map runtime/resolver source categories to canonical Action codes at the boundary, and leave generic manifest/result validation unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The OpenCode manifest declares execution-unavailable, skill-not-found, provider-quota-exhausted, and unsupported-execution-configuration in lowercase kebab-case.
The Pi manifest declares skill-not-found, provider-quota-exhausted, incompatible-runtime, and interrupted in lowercase kebab-case.
Neither manifest declares source underscore categories such as execution_unavailable, skill_not_found, or unsupported_execution_configuration, or invalid-input/unexpected-error/timeout.
The established unsupported_execution_configuration runtime diagnostic and recorded category remains unchanged, while the Action boundary maps it to unsupported-execution-configuration.
The Skill resolver source category skill_not_found maps to skill-not-found for both Agent Actions; provider-quota-exhausted, incompatible-runtime, and interrupted retain canonical spelling.
Every newly declared code passes through generic normalization and recovery unchanged.
A truly undeclared ActionResult code remains normalized to unexpected-error.
No validator exception, reserved-code weakening, global Action error enum, or unrelated Action behavior change is introduced.
tasks.output: Manifest-complete OpenCode Action error contract and explicit runtime-to-Action code mapping.
tasks.notes: Future implementation task. Spec artifact validation for this change is complete in the design-first PR.
